# vastdata_nfs_certificate (Resource)

Manages the **NFS** (NFSv4 RPC-with-TLS) server certificate.

Uses `PATCH /clusters/{id}/` (`nfs4_certificate`, `nfs4_private_key`). Available on VAST 5.4+.

Destroy is a no-op: removing this resource does not clear the NFS certificate.

This resource is not importable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_nfs_certificate" "nfs" {
  cluster_id  = 1
  certificate = file("path/to/tls.crt")
  private_key = file("path/to/tls.key")
}

# ---------------------
# Complete examples
# ---------------------

# e2e: install NFSv4 RPC-with-TLS certificate (write-only PEMs + certificate_md5).
# Not importable; destroy is a no-op.
resource "vastdata_nfs_certificate" "vastdb_nfs_certificate" {
  cluster_id  = 1
  certificate = <<-EOT
    -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
    .
    .  <content>
    .
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
  EOT
  private_key = <<-EOT
    -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
    .
    .  <content>
    .
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----
  EOT
}

# --------------------
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PEM-encoded certificate (leaf plus optional chain).
- `cluster_id` (Number) ID of the cluster that hosts NFSv4 (typically 1).
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) PEM-encoded private key.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_md5` (String) MD5 of the leaf certificate DER (lowercase hex). Computed from certificate at plan time so a new certificate is applied automatically. Not settable.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the leaf certificate DER, lowercase hex.
- `not_after` (String) Not-after (expiry) of the leaf certificate, RFC3339 UTC.
- `subject` (String) Subject of the leaf certificate.
